title: Chess, But SCP-049 C̶̣̗͗̍ŭ̶̦̯͎r̶̢͂e̷̟̓̃s Your Pieces
summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish with neutral SCP-049 (the Plague Doctor) on b4. Each round it moves one square orthogonally in a random direction and 'cures' every adjacent piece, turning it into an immortal neutral zombie. Zombies belong to no one, cannot be captured, move randomly each round (pawns may move forward or backward and promote into zombie queens), and capture white and black pieces alike. The doctor zombifies White's queenside early; later the zombie horde drifts toward Stockfish's uncastled king and the narrator captures the exposed king to win.
rules: Standard chess otherwise; player White vs Stockfish (3600); king-capture used to finish (narrator 'takes the enemy king').
Neutral SCP-049 starts on b4 and moves one square orthogonally in a random direction each round.
After it moves, every piece (either colour) adjacent to it becomes a zombie.

Zombies are neutral, immortal (cannot be captured), and each round make a random move with their piece movement; zombie pawns can move forward or backward and promote (to zombie queens) on either back rank; a zombie with no moves skips.
Zombies capture any piece of either colour, kings included.
win_condition: Checkmate or capture the black king.
